items.title: Alkanes aur cycloalkanes ki shaklein (print mein doosra 11.2.3) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Shapes of Alkanes and Cycloalkanes, printed as a second 11.2.3, pages 249-251.

blocks.text: Alkane mein carbon atom ke chaar sp3 hybridised orbitals hote hain aur woh chaar single bonds banata hai jo ek doosre se barabar faasle par hain (Figure 11.4), to alkane molecules har carbon ke gird tetrahedral shakal rakhte hain. Alkanes mein carbon atoms ird-gird ke carbon aur hydrogen atoms se sigma bonds banate hain, to har carbon bonding electrons ke chaar joron se ghira hai jo ek doosre ko barabar dhakelte hain, 109.5 degrees ke bond angles aur 1.54 angstrom ki C-C bond length dete hue. Organic molecules ki shaklein aam taur par ball-and-stick formulas se dikhai jati hain; Table 11.4 methane CH4, ethane C2H6, propane C3H8 aur butane C4H10 dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Orbital khaaka. Methane: darmiyani C se chaar neele sp3 lobes, har ek ke sire par peela H; do lobes ke darmiyan qaus par 109.5 degree; 'sp3 hybrid tetrahedral'. Ethane: do carbons, har ek ke teen lobes H tak, aur dono carbons ke darmiyan do lobes seedha (end-on) overlap karte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.4: sp3 hybridised methane aur ethane (kitab ki Figure 11.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Methane (oopar) aur ethane (neeche) ke ball-and-stick models. Methane mein chaar hydrogen carbon ke gird tetrahedron ke konon par hain, aur surkh qaus 109.5 degree ka bond angle dikhati hai. Ethane mein do carbon jamni C-C sigma bond se jure hain aur har carbon par teen hydrogen hain. Har C-H bond par naranji saaya sp3-s sigma overlap dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: sp3 hybridised methane aur ethane: hamara apna 3D model (kitab ki Figure 11.4 oopar 2D khaake mein hai; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Carbon apna 2s aur teen 2p orbitals mila kar chaar barabar sp3 orbitals banata hai jo tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf 109.5 degree ke fasle par hain. Methane mein har sp3 orbital hydrogen ke 1s orbital se seedha (end-on) overlap kar ke chaar C-H sigma bonds banata hai. Ethane mein har carbon ka aik sp3 orbital end-on overlap se C-C sigma bond banata hai aur baqi teen hydrogen se judte hain, kul chhe C-H sigma bonds.

fallback.text: Methane aur ethane: har carbon sp3 hai, us ke chaar sigma bonds tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf 109.5 degree ke fasle par hain.
fallback.alt: 3D model ki tasveer: sp3 hybridised methane aur ethane.

blocks.text: Cycloalkanes cyclic hain, yani molecule ke carbon atoms halqe ki shakal mein tarteeb diye hain, aur saturated, yani halqe ke sab carbons doosre atoms se single bonds se jure hain. Table 11.5 cyclopropane C3H6, cyclobutane C4H8 aur cyclopentane C5H10 (print mein C4H10) dikhati hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke alkanes ki shakal tetrahedral kyun hai, aur cyclopropane aur cyclopentane ki shaklein banayein (Quick Check 11.2b, c).
blocks.explanation: Har alkane carbon sp3 hybridised hai jis ke chaar bonding pairs aur koi lone pair nahi; chaar pairs ek doosre ko barabar dhakel kar jitna ho sake door, 109.5 degrees par, theherte hain, jo tetrahedral tarteeb hai. Cyclopropane teen CH2 groups ka tikon aur cyclopentane paanch CH2 groups ka panj-kona hai, har kona ek carbon.

items: Alkane carbon: sp3, chaar sigma bonds, tetrahedral, 109.5 degrees, C-C 1.54 angstrom; cycloalkanes saturated halqe hain (cyclopropane C3H6, cyclobutane C4H8, cyclopentane C5H10).
